run_fftnd_array: run fftn on a multi-dimensional array to compute the n-dimensional discrete Fourier transform
run_ifftnd_array: run ifftn on a multi-dimensional array to compute the inverse n-dimensional discrete Fourier transform
run_rfftnd_real_array: run rfftn on a real-valued multi-dimensional array to compute the n-dimensional discrete Fourier transform
run_irfftnd_real_array: run irfftn on a real-valued multi-dimensional array to compute the inverse n-dimensional discrete Fourier transform
run_fftshift_array: run fftshift on a multi-dimensional array to shift the zero-frequency component to the center of the spectrum
